label: FP
reason: The user-supplied parameter from the HTTP header is sanitized via ESAPI's encodeForHTML() before being concatenated into the HTML response body. This prevents XSS in the displayed text. Although a Cookie named 'SomeCookie' is also created with the unsanitized value, cookies are sent over HTTPS (setSecure=true) and stored separately from the page rendering context, so they do not constitute an XSS vector in the browser DOM where the script would execute.

evidence.note: User input is encoded for HTML context before insertion into the response writer, mitigating XSS.
Cookie is set with Secure and HttpOnly flags, preventing JavaScript access even if the value were unencoded.
